description: Every established Agent in a segment with its level, closes left, closes missed, last challenge_eligible epoch and estimated drop close (observed L + 7 rule, an estimate). level narrows to one level. Use it for 'who is at risk' across the segment; for one Agent use get_standing.

dir.description: desc (default: the key's natural order, highest first for numbers, A to Z for names, fewest closes left first for left, a level in its order) or asc (reversed); blanks last either way

limit.description: maximum Agents to return (1 to 5000, default 200)

segment.description: chain segment: omit for the current one; 1 reads segment 1 (archived at the 2026-10-24 genesis cut), whose epoch numbers repeat in the current segment

sort.description: level (soonest drop first, default), score or a Score part, name (A to Z), left (fewest closes left first), missed, last (last cleared close) or drop (drop close)

name: list_governance_standing
title: Governance standing
